messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: High metering emit lag detected for emitter-10. Potential token-count drift and delayed usage reports. Auto-severity: high :rotating_light:
Maya (oncall): on it, looking at emitter-10 logs
Maya (oncall): raj, can you join? lina please confirm customer-facing impact
Raj: joining. pulling last 6m logs from emitter-10
Raj: ```ERROR emitter-10: ack_timeout=12s sequence_gap=0x4f3e current_seq=1045231 expected_seq=1045219``` 
Lina - Billing: preliminary: we see delayed usage batches; some customers flagged overages erroneously. rough numbers: ~120 accounts (~1.1%) saw late overage flags between 06:12-06:28 UTC
Oliver (Support): which customers? need to notify CS and hold off billing alerts if possible
Maya (oncall): Sam can we pause outbound overage notifications? or silence webhooks for billing alerts
Sam - Platform: we can flip the notifications flag in feature-toggle for billing-notify; will need a quick PR/merge + prod toggle. estimate ~10m
Raj: root cause looks like emitter commit ack retries after transient kafka lag; messages got re-emitted with different sequence leading to double-counting in aggregator
Raj: working on a mitigation: stop-emitter on emitter-10 and restart with strict dedupe
deploy-bot: deploy queued: hotfix/metric-dedupe -> env=prod by Raj (manual review required)
Maya (oncall): Raj please coordinate deploy. Lina prepare mitigation message for CS. Oliver prepare inbound support playbook
Raj: starting hotfix deploy now, will monitor for 5m
Raj: hotfix applied to emitter-10, restarting... logs now show no ack_timeout
Raj: ```INFO emitter-10: dedupe-mode=on commit_ok=true restart_seq=1045232``` 
Lina - Billing: seeing counts reconcile in dashboard. delayed batches backfilled; overage flags retracted for 95% of affected accounts. still 6 accounts showing persistent discrepancy, investigating billing ledger
Oliver (Support): I'll open a CS ticket for the 6 accounts and prepare customer notes. holding any billing emails until all reconciled
Maya (oncall): handoff: I'm on-call for another 30m but passing incident ownership to Raj for followups; Raj will be primary until 14:00 PT
Raj: acknowledged. will monitor metrics and confirm full reconciliation. also will run a targeted backfill for the 6 accounts
Sam - Platform: added a short-term probe to alert on emitter ack_timeout >5s to detect recurrence
Maya (oncall): thanks team. postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause, mitigation, customer comms, prevention (consumer backpressure/guardrail)
Oliver (Support): tagging CS:cs-team and legal for possible refunds question
deploy-bot: deploy completed: hotfix/metric-dedupe -> prod (id: d-98123) :white_check_mark:
Raj: reconciled counts match expected for 99.7% of traffic after backfill. closing active mitigation. will put an RCA draft in #eng-postmortems
Lina - Billing: estimating customer impact: 1.1% experienced noisy overage flags, ~0.02% had persistent ledger discrepancy requiring manual fix
Maya (oncall): closing the pager, keep this thread for updates. good job folks :thumbsup:
